📢 On Saturday, November 21, the Office of the UN High Commissioner for Human Rights in Colombia called for an independent investigation into the death of Ivonne Fernanda Parra Díaz, a young woman with Down syndrome and respiratory conditions, which occurred in El Bordo, in the department of Cauca, following a police crackdown involving tear gas during the protests on November 19. ⚖️ Social organizations in Cauca reported that riot police units did not comply with the request to suspend the operation in order to evacuate her, while the police stated that they acted in response to attacks with improvised explosive devices and maintained that forensic authorities must determine whether there is a connection to her death, which occurred on November 20. ✊ The events occurred during the national day of action called by unions and social movements against the policies of Abelardo De La Espriella’s government.
